cyclePolicy: One candidate per scheduled cycle. Refresh queue first. Skip blocked entries unless their unblock condition has become true.

processed.blocker: Public full body is now readable without login, but real screenshot/source assets remain unacquired and rights/privacy/defamation/human review is incomplete.
processed.unblockWhen: A real user/manual source screenshot or otherwise permitted source asset is added; do not automate login, anti-bot, paywall, or access-control bypass.

queueRefresh.note: Directory metadata reports 30 candidate files while the stored queue has 15. Missing filenames were not guessed; exact filename-level expansion remains pending.

notes: Changed unblock condition rechecked: full-body-read blocker cleared for the first candidate, but C1/A0/P0 remains. No screenshot, OCR, moderation, rights clearance, A1, or P1 is claimed.
